name: Litter Picking App
tagline: Community app for organising litter clean-ups and plogging sessions in Dutch towns
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: Onboarding into a home community
scenes.body: New members pick their town, such as Brielle or Zeist, then allow location access, which plogging needs.

scenes.title: A personal impact dashboard
scenes.body: Kilograms cleaned and steps plogged from the user profile, then waste reports, news and upcoming sessions.

scenes.title: Find and join local communities
scenes.body: Towns expand into neighbourhood groups; each page shows its leader, members, sessions and kg collected.

scenes.title: Session list and PIN sign-in
scenes.body: Upcoming clean-up sessions with turnout; sign-in sends email and PIN to the REST API and keeps the token.
